attchmntText: Black Box Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release on Unaudited Financial Results Q2FY27".
voiceSummary: Black Box Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue of 1,936 crore for Q2 FY27, up 22% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at 175 crore, up 23% year-on-year. Profit after tax was 73 crore, up 31% year-on-year. The order backlog reached 1,044 million US dollars, an 88% increase year-on-year. New order bookings for the quarter were 298 million US dollars. For the half year, revenue was 3,655 crore and EBITDA was 335 crore. The company provided FY27 guidance projecting revenue growth of 23% to 27% and PAT growth of 38% to 50%. The filing was submitted to the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Black Box Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Black Box Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board considered both Standalone and Consolidated results. MSKA & Associates LLP issued a Limited Review Report on the Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results. The auditors noted delays in remittance of import payments, repatriation of export proceeds, and other receipts aggregating to Rs. 20.44 crores, Rs. 7.44 crores, and Rs. 11.14 crores respectively, as at September 30, 2026. Management has filed applications for extension of time limits and condonation of delays, with responses awaited. The auditors' conclusion is not modified regarding this matter. The Standalone Unaudited Financial Results were also reviewed and approved by the Board.

attchmntText: Black Box Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Black Box Limited has intimated the schedule of analyst and institutional investor meetings under SEBI Listing Regulations. Company officials will attend a one-on-one or group meeting with JM Financial Institutional Securities Limited in Mumbai on November 16, 2026, starting at 9:00 am. Additionally, officials will participate in the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference in Mumbai on November 17, 2026, starting at 9:00 am. Discussions will be based on publicly available information. No unpublished price sensitive information is intended to be discussed. Changes may occur due to exigencies.

attchmntText: Black Box Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Black Box Limited has announced an earnings call for the second quarter and half-year financial results of fiscal year 2027. The call is scheduled for Saturday, November 14, 2026, at 10:00 A.M. IST. Participants include Mr. Sanjeev Verma, Whole Time Director and CEO, Mr. Deepak Bansal, Executive Director and Global CFO, and Mr. Purvesh Parekh, Head of Investor Relations. The company has provided dial-in numbers for local and international access, including toll-free lines for Hong Kong, Singapore, the UK, and the USA. Stakeholders are requested to pre-register via the provided link. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. The announcement was issued by Company Secretary Aditya Goswami on November 9, 2026.
